description: Serial letter as ONE print file: fills an HTML document template (template_id or key, see list_document_templates) for every recipient — saved_filter_id, filter or ids; entity contacts (default) or accounts — renders each as PDF via the tenant's browser service and joins them into one PDF stored as a document. Same placeholders as group e-mails (all values HTML-escaped). Max 100 letters per call; for more use offset (returns next_offset). Returns document_id and a download link.

filter.description: Recipient filter as in search_crm (alternative to saved_filter_id or ids)

ids.description: Explicit recipient record IDs (alternative to saved_filter_id or filter)

key.description: Key of the document template (alternative to template_id)

offset.description: Number of entries to skip (for paging)

title.description: Title of the resulting PDF document

name: render_serial_letters
